renderContract.commonPrompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: premium choice-protected-value constellation-afterglow guardian card master artwork, full-bleed 3:4. Show exactly the named single guardian or canonical internal pair and no extra adviser, partner, audience, future self, human, silhouette, reflection, empty seat or implied person. Use the same-sign human-approved B081 artwork as the primary identity, eye, palette and rendering anchor; use B080 only as a broken-afterglow spacing reference and never copy its composition. Preserve canonical body, relative scale, colors, clothing, signature props, dark-purple outlines and visible chest Stella stars. Eye construction is a hard gate: approved white sclera, matched purple irises, coherent pupils and gaze aimed at one intended target, and consistent highlights; reject button eyes, crossed or divergent gaze without a target, duplicated or warped eyes, and mismatched iris size. Guardian or pair plus one protected core, one visibly separate adjustable element and one blank revisiting marker covers 55–65% and reads at 80px. Between them show only two or three disconnected afterglow patches with broad empty gaps; never draw a connected constellation, route, verdict, destiny, guaranteed return or correct choice. Written surfaces use isolated symbols and geometric reliefs only: no readable text, pseudo-text, names, labels, score, number, date, clock face, calendar grid, map, coordinate, question mark, zodiac glyph, arrow, logo or watermark. Do not bake actual birth-chart lines or personal colors into the master art. Every boundary, support, tray, recess and marker remains broken, open-sided, notched, loose, removable or unlatched; no key, lock, closed circle, ring, halo, portal, infinity sign, cage or deterministic path. Do not add a scale to any sign. Only Scorpio canonical tail-heart is allowed; no added heart. Keep every composition distinct from B001–83 and from the other eleven cards. Soft colored-pencil and watercolor with visible paper grain, rounded plush proportions and dreamy violet-peach-gold lighting; no naturalistic-animal drift, rough crayon, flat vector, readable text, logo or watermark.
